content: A LangSmith trace is a tree of runs. Each run has name, run_type, inputs, outputs, start and end time, error, and optional token and cost fields. run_type separates chain, llm, prompt, parser, tool, and retriever. LLM inputs and outputs are typically message arrays. Latency, tokens, and cost are queryable but are production-trace fields, not required to see what a step did. Source: https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/run-data-format
